items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: Well, so really your biggest kicks -- Louis was probably one of your biggest kicks. That was my biggest kick.

ctx.x: What kind of blowing was Clark doing at that time?

He -- Clark can play any way that you like for him to play. He even played like Louis Armstrong, on -- four or five numbers, and just knocked Basie out. Basie didn't know he could do it like that. But he did. And he was just a versatile guy. He's a good trumpet player, he really is.
Barnett was saying the other day, that's the best. There's nobody as good.
